{{Quote|Hammer 4:3 is down.|Imperial commander to [[343.245/H5]]|<ref name="Hammer of Destiny">{{WEGCite|story=Hammer of Destiny|book=Imperial Entanglements (Star Wars Miniatures Battles)}}</ref>}}
'''Hammer 4:3''' was a [[S-1 FireHawke Heavy Repulsortank]] in the [[Imperial Hammers Elite Armor Unit/Legends|Imperial Hammers Elite Armor Unit]]. During the [[Battle of Turak IV]], it sustained severe damage and was left behind by the rest of the [[Regiment/Legends|regiment]]. It became a centerpoint of combat itself, as [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] and [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] retrieval teams, both determined to retrieve the vehicle, clashed.

The crew of Hammer 4:3 consisted of five elite [[Land assault trooper|Imperial Army assault troopers]], armed with [[Blaster carbine/Legends|blaster carbines]] and [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistols]].
